verdict.rationale: The pack only incidentally shows a version label ('graph-rest-1.0') inside link URLs. Nothing describes an API versioning scheme, version lifecycle, or deprecation policy, so the story's core element (a documented deprecation policy to rely on) is unevidenced. The community items are about client UX and are off-topic.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
